properties.evidence: schema/verify.yaml gives a Verification one `status` enum (planned/passing/failing/skipped/blocked/superseded) as its only machine-read outcome. Every rollup (loop_status by_status and attention, coverage_report, the unproven-capability gap) keys on it, and `findings` is free text nothing parses. So a qualified run can only be recorded as a plain pass or a plain fail (measured on 0.72.0).
